name: Vantone Neo Development Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Vantone Neo Development Group Co., Ltd. engages in the development and sale of real estate properties. Its property portfolio includes residential, commercial, and office buildings, as well as shops. The company also provides property management, real estate brokerage, real estate information consulting, project and investment management, and asset management services, as well as design, production, agency, and advertising services. In addition, it offers conference, technology promotion, general construction contracting, professional contracting, and sports project management services; hosts exhibitions; and sells stationery, building materials, computer software, hardware, and peripheral equipment. Further, the company provides technology development and consulting; communication and entertainment technology solutions; operations management; culture media; and investment and financing management services. The company was founded in 1991 and is based in Beijing, China.
